public_data_status: Frozen unseen-channel holdout; official test labels used only for final evaluation

manifest.selection_rule: For each mission, exclude development channels, rank remaining channel IDs by SHA-256 of 'astra-phase1c-v1:<mission>:<channel>', and take the first 10

frozen_configuration.selection_basis: Combined-method validation score using normal public train-validation false alerts and separately labelled synthetic validation sensitivity; no official test labels or results used
frozen_configuration.event_matching_rule: Detected event start must be inside a labelled interval or within tolerance; pre-existing alerts outside tolerance do not match; tolerated early starts have zero delay

combined_detector_judgement: Combined did not clear the predeclared bar of higher point F1, no lower event recall, and no higher false-alert rate; the stronger simpler baseline is preferred.
